path: 上達のためのテクニック

intro.ja:
藤井猛の相振り飛車を指しこなす本は、１巻が金無双中心、２巻が美濃、３・４巻が３三角戦法の応用という出典の分類です。相振りは対抗形と攻める向きが違うため、囲いの名前だけでなく、縦の攻めと端の弱点を学びます。全てを一度に暗記する必要はありません。

相振り戦の絶対手筋１０５は序盤から終盤の技術、囲いの破り方は縦からの美濃や穴熊崩しにも対応します。専門書は石田流の相振り編、角交換四間飛車最新ガイド、中飛車左穴熊へ分かれます。自分の飛車の位置と角交換の有無を軸に、実戦で使う分野を選びましょう。
intro.en:
The source divides Fujii’s Double Ranging Rook series into Gold Fortress foundations, Mino play, and later bishop-on-3c applications. Attack directions differ from Static-versus-Ranging Rook games, so study vertical pressure and edge weaknesses rather than relying on a castle’s familiar name. Build understanding of the basic plans before attempting every advanced branch.

The 105-technique collection covers recurring ideas across game stages, while the castle-breaking collection includes vertical attacks against Mino and Anaguma. Specialized reading divides into Ishida against ranging systems, Bishop Exchange Fourth File Rook, and Central Rook Left Anaguma. Match the book to your rook’s file and whether bishops have been exchanged; these conditions change the plans you can actually use.

question.ja: 相振りの専門書を選ぶ軸は？
question.en: What guides specialized Double Ranging Rook reading?

answer.ja: 自分の飛車の位置、角交換の有無、相手の囲いです。
answer.en: Your rook’s file, bishop-exchange status, and the opponent’s castle.
